title: GDELT Geopolitical Tension Events
description: Article-level geopolitical conflict/tension signal from the GDELT Project 2.0 DOC API (48-hour window, up to 250 headlines). Articles are classified into durable themes - RUSSIA_UKRAINE_WAR, TAIWAN_STRAIT_TENSION, MIDDLE_EAST_CONFLICT, IRAN_TENSION, KOREAN_PENINSULA, SOUTH_CHINA_SEA, INDIA_PAKISTAN, VENEZUELA_GUYANA, NATO_RUSSIA, SANCTIONS_ACTIVITY - each carrying an investment thesis (defence names RTX/LMT/GD, oil risk premium USO/XLE, gold safe haven GLD/GDX, country-ETF risk like EWY/INDA/EWT, semiconductor supply TSM). Unclassified headlines are dropped to keep context focused. Volume per theme is the signal - Claude downstream reads density, not individual articles. Free GDELT DOC API, no auth.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    'article_url', 'title', 'domain', 'language', 'source_country',
    'seen_date', 'tension_theme', 'actor_region',
    'investment_thesis', 'severity_tier', '_epoch',
]

THEMES = [
    {'needles': ['ukraine', 'kyiv', 'donetsk', 'kharkiv', 'zelensky'], 'theme': 'RUSSIA_UKRAINE_WAR', 'region': 'Eastern Europe', 'thesis': 'Defence (RTX, LMT, GD, NOC), European natgas (UNG), grains (WEAT, CORN)'},
    {'needles': ['taiwan', 'tsmc', 'taipei', 'taiwan strait'], 'theme': 'TAIWAN_STRAIT_TENSION', 'region': 'Indo-Pacific', 'thesis': 'TSM tail risk, semi supply (INTC, MU), defence (LMT), gold'},
    {'needles': ['israel', 'gaza', 'palestin', 'lebanon', 'hezbollah', 'hamas', 'houthi'], 'theme': 'MIDDLE_EAST_CONFLICT', 'region': 'Middle East', 'thesis': 'Oil risk premium (USO, XLE), defence (RTX, LMT), gold (GLD)'},
    {'needles': ['iran', 'tehran', 'hormuz', 'persian gulf', 'strait of hormuz'], 'theme': 'IRAN_TENSION', 'region': 'Persian Gulf', 'thesis': 'Oil supply risk (WTI, USO), tanker/shipping insurance cost'},
    {'needles': ['north korea', 'pyongyang', 'dprk', 'icbm'], 'theme': 'KOREAN_PENINSULA', 'region': 'East Asia', 'thesis': 'KOSPI risk (EWY), JPY safe haven (FXY), defence primes'},
    {'needles': ['south china sea', 'spratly', 'philippines china'], 'theme': 'SOUTH_CHINA_SEA', 'region': 'Indo-Pacific', 'thesis': 'Shipping lanes risk, China tensions (FXI short / hedge), EPHE'},
    {'needles': ['india pakistan', 'kashmir', 'line of control'], 'theme': 'INDIA_PAKISTAN', 'region': 'South Asia', 'thesis': 'INDA drawdown risk, nuclear-neighbour tail (GLD)'},
    {'needles': ['venezuela', 'guyana'], 'theme': 'VENEZUELA_GUYANA', 'region': 'South America', 'thesis': 'ExxonMobil (XOM) Guyana exposure, oil markets'},
    {'needles': ['nato', 'kremlin', 'moscow'], 'theme': 'NATO_RUSSIA', 'region': 'Europe', 'thesis': 'European defence ETFs (ITA), natural gas (UNG), energy security'},
    {'needles': ['sanctions', 'sanction'], 'theme': 'SANCTIONS_ACTIVITY', 'region': 'Global', 'thesis': 'Company-specific: identify target, short the ADR; long compliance vendors'},
]

def classify_theme(title_lower):
    for ti in range(len(THEMES)):
        entry = THEMES[ti]
        needles = entry['needles']
        for ni in range(len(needles)):
            if needles[ni] in title_lower:
                return {'theme': entry['theme'], 'region': entry['region'], 'thesis': entry['thesis']}
    return {'theme': 'OTHER', 'region': 'Global', 'thesis': 'Unclassified - monitor for escalation'}

def severity_from_theme(theme):
    high_priority = ('RUSSIA_UKRAINE_WAR', 'TAIWAN_STRAIT_TENSION', 'MIDDLE_EAST_CONFLICT', 'IRAN_TENSION', 'KOREAN_PENINSULA')
    if theme in high_priority:
        return 'HIGH'
    return 'MODERATE'

QUERY = '(conflict OR missile OR invasion OR ceasefire OR sanctions OR airstrike OR troops OR warhead OR diplomat)'

articles = []
api_status = 'ok'
api_detail = ''
try:
    # NOTE: GDELT's /doc API has TWO silent-429 footguns:
    #   (1) case-sensitive `mode` and `sort` (caught 2026-05-02)  - 
    #       capital `mode=ArtList` / `sort=DateDesc` trigger a 429
    #       response page. Use lowercase artlist/datedesc.
    #   (2) OR-joined query terms must be wrapped in parens (caught
    #       2026-05-06) - `a OR b OR c` returns 429 with body
    #       'Please limit requests to one every 5 seconds';
    #       `(a OR b OR c)` returns 200 with the article list. The
    #       script was silently writing API_ERROR sentinels every
    #       run between 2026-05-02 and 2026-05-06 because of this.
    # See script_library QUERY constant above for the wrapped form.
    resp = requests.get(
        'https://api.gdeltproject.org/api/v2/doc/doc',
        params={
            'query': QUERY,
            'mode': 'artlist',
            'maxrecords': 250,
            'sort': 'datedesc',
            'timespan': '2d',
            'format': 'json',
        },
        headers={'User-Agent': 'speakesquery (macro-brief) ingestion'},
        timeout=60,
    )
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        api_status = 'rate_limited'
        api_detail = (resp.text or '')[:300]
    elif resp.status_code != 200:
        api_status = 'error_' + str(resp.status_code)
        api_detail = (resp.text or '')[:300]
    else:
        try:
            payload = resp.json() or {}
        except Exception:
            payload = {}
            api_status = 'parse_error'
            api_detail = (resp.text or '')[:200]
        raw = payload.get('articles', []) or []
        if isinstance(raw, list):
            articles = raw
        else:
            api_status = 'shape_error'
            api_detail = 'response.articles not a list (got: ' + str(raw)[:80] + ')'
except Exception as exc:
    api_status = 'fetch_error'
    api_detail = (str(exc) or '')[:300]
    articles = []

rows = []
for ai in range(len(articles)):
    art = articles[ai]
    if not isinstance(art, dict):
        continue
    title = str(art.get('title', '') or '')
    if not title:
        continue
    title_lower = title.lower()
    match = classify_theme(title_lower)
    theme = match['theme']
    region = match['region']
    thesis = match['thesis']
    if theme == 'OTHER':
        continue
    severity = severity_from_theme(theme)
    rows.append({
        'article_url': str(art.get('url', '') or ''),
        'title': title[:300],
        'domain': str(art.get('domain', '') or ''),
        'language': str(art.get('language', '') or ''),
        'source_country': str(art.get('sourcecountry', '') or ''),
        'seen_date': str(art.get('seendate', '') or ''),
        'tension_theme': theme,
        'actor_region': region,
        'investment_thesis': thesis,
        'severity_tier': severity,
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

if rows:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['article_url']).reset_index(drop=True)
    df = df.sort_values(['tension_theme', 'seen_date'], ascending=[True, False]).reset_index(drop=True)
elif api_status != 'ok':
    # Emit a single sentinel row when the API failed so the brief
    # surfaces the problem instead of silently rendering empty.
    # Downstream SPQL feeders should filter sentinel rows via
    # `where tension_theme != "API_ERROR"` if they want a clean
    # signal-only feed.
    df = pd.DataFrame([{
        'article_url': '',
        'title': 'GDELT API call failed: ' + api_status,
        'domain': 'api.gdeltproject.org',
        'language': '',
        'source_country': '',
        'seen_date': now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'),
        'tension_theme': 'API_ERROR',
        'actor_region': 'Diagnostic',
        'investment_thesis': api_detail or 'GDELT /doc/doc returned no articles - investigate',
        'severity_tier': 'INFO',
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    }], columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
else:
    # API call succeeded but no articles matched our themes. Emit
    # a benign sentinel so the brief sees "quiet day" rather than
    # treating the feeder as broken.
    df = pd.DataFrame([{
        'article_url': '',
        'title': 'No qualifying geopolitical-tension articles in last 48h',
        'domain': 'api.gdeltproject.org',
        'language': '',
        'source_country': '',
        'seen_date': now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'),
        'tension_theme': 'NO_SIGNAL',
        'actor_region': 'Global',
        'investment_thesis': 'GDELT scan returned ' + str(len(articles)) + ' raw articles, none matched curated themes',
        'severity_tier': 'INFO',
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    }], columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
